subject: Coord: global demo — aligning exec windows across US/EU/APAC (DST-aware)
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna.li@evocard.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@evocard.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 16:10:00 +0100
Subject: Request: Global product demo — 3-region execs

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. We're excited to see Redwood's inference runtime for a potential pilot. Our exec group (US West CEO, Germany CTO, Singapore Head of Ops) want a 60-minute exec-level demo and are hoping to do it during the week of Oct 26–30 if possible.

High level asks:
- 45 min executive walkthrough (latency/cost/SLAs) + 15 min Q&A
- One senior engineering lead from our side will join (Tom Harris)
- We need the slot to avoid forcing anyone into the deep overnight if we can — appreciate this is tricky across US/EU/APAC.

Can you propose 2–3 candidate slots (please list in UTC and local times) and flag any DST caveats? Our VP is flexible but prefers not to be on calls before 08:30 PDT.

Cheers,
Anna Li
Head of Product
Evocard

Attachments: evocard_context.pdf (overview)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@evocard.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Global product demo — 3-region execs

Anna — thanks, this is helpful. Two quick notes up front:
1) EU daylight saving time ends on Sun Oct 25 this year, so local offsets for Europe will change between Oct 24 and Oct 26. To avoid confusion we'll anchor proposed slots in UTC and list the converted local times post-DST.
2) Given the exec-level audience, we can do either: a single 60-min cross-region call (likely pushing APAC to late-night), or a shorter exec call + a recorded deep-dive for APAC.

Candidate slots (anchored to UTC, then local):
- Option A: 2026-10-28 16:00 UTC (US West: 09:00 PDT, Germany: 17:00 CET, Singapore: 00:00 SGT [Oct 29])
- Option B: 2026-10-29 14:00 UTC (US West: 07:00 PDT, Germany: 15:00 CET, Singapore: 22:00 SGT)
- Option C: 2026-10-28 12:00 UTC (US West: 05:00 PDT — too early for your VP), Germany: 13:00 CET, Singapore: 20:00 SGT)

If you want to avoid any midnight in APAC, Option B looks least painful for Singapore (22:00). If the APAC execs absolutely cannot be late evening, we recommend Option A as exec overview and then schedule a 30-minute APAC follow-up at a comfortable local time — we can record the exec session so APAC execs don't miss the top-level narrative.

I've attached a short mutual action plan and a one-pager with the demo agenda. If one of these works, I'll send a calendar invite with all execs and our engineering leads.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
Attachments: evocard_mutual_action_plan.xlsx, demo-brief-Redwood.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@evocard.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Global product demo — 3-region execs

Looping in to flag internal exec availability constraints: our VP (EMEA relationships) can only join in the late afternoon CET (post 16:30 CET) on Tue–Thu that week. Our CTO prefers mornings PDT. To keep this manageable, can we please: 
- Narrow to two preferred windows that satisfy both (we suggested midday UTC options so Europe is late afternoon and US West is morning), and
- Decide whether we record and provide an APAC-specific deep-dive within 48 hours.

Two narrowed picks from our side:
- Pick 1: 2026-10-28 16:00 UTC — fits our EMEA VP and US West morning; APAC will be late night (00:00 SGT next day).
- Pick 2: 2026-10-29 14:00 UTC — better for APAC (22:00) but forces our CTO to join at 07:00 PDT.

If Evocard prefers not to have any participant after 22:00 local, we'll need to go with the hybrid approach (exec call + recorded + local deep-dive).

–Marissa
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Anna Li <anna.li@evocard.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@evocard.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 02:18:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Global product demo — 3-region execs

Thanks for the clarity, team. Quick responses from our execs after internal sync:
- US West CEO: prefers not earlier than 08:30 PDT.
- Germany CTO: flexible late afternoon CET.
- Singapore Head of Ops: will tolerate up to 23:00 SGT but prefers earlier.

Given that, Option B (2026-10-29 14:00 UTC) would keep APAC at 22:00 which is just inside their limit, but it means our CEO is at 07:00 PDT (not ideal).

We'd accept Option A (2026-10-28 16:00 UTC) only if:
- Redwood records the session and provides a 30–45 minute follow-up (live or recorded) tailored to APAC at a reasonable hour, and
- The agenda is tightly curated to the executive audience — no heavy architecture deep-dive.

If you can confirm both, let's lock 2026-10-28 16:00 UTC and we'll circulate it to our execs. Also please include a short agenda (3 bullets) in the invite.

Best,
Anna
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@evocard.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Oct 2026 12:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: Global product demo — 3-region execs

Anna — that works for us. Proposal to operationalize the hybrid approach:
- Lock the executive session: 2026-10-28 16:00 UTC (60 min).
  - Agenda (high level):
    1) Executive summary: business impact & TCO levers (10 min)
    2) Live demo: latency/rollouts/fallbacks at scale (30 min)
    3) Q&A and next steps (20 min)
- We'll record the session and produce a 30–45 minute condensed recording with timestamps for APAC stakeholders within 24 hours.
- Schedule a follow-up APAC deep-dive (30 min) for the week after — we can propose local-friendly windows (SGT business hours).

I'll create the calendar invite and include a short recording plan + the mutual action plan (attached). Dylan — can you send the invite and we can CC the exec distribution lists?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
From: Anna Li <anna.li@evocard.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@evocard.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Global product demo — 3-region execs

Confirmed — Evocard execs will join the 2026-10-28 16:00 UTC executive session. Please include the short agenda in the invite and note that we expect the recording and the APAC follow-up proposal within 24 hours.

Also include the attendee list in the invite (CEO, CTO, Head of Ops, Tom Harris). I'll send a calendar acceptance as soon as the invite hits our calendars.

Appreciate the flexibility. Looking forward to the demo.

Anna Li
Head of Product | Evocard
